visual_brief.subject: A coding-agent workflow spends modest effort on drafting, deeper effort on parallel workspace inspection, and enters repair only when a judge requests it
verified_context: HydraFusion now uses medium reasoning effort for initial drafts and high effort for review.
Critique uses tools to inspect the workspace and parallel critic models.
Cascade can judge initial work and request repair only when needed; HydraFusion Max applies higher effort on demanding tasks.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Review becomes a separate, deeper execution phase grounded in the real workspace rather than the draft model's summary.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A restrained clay drafting stream feeds a layered artifact into a deep stone inspection chamber, where three independent lenses examine it before a brass judge diverts flawed material through a compact repair loop.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. A simple drafting stream enters a much deeper three-lens inspection chamber, and the separate brass gate plus repair loop remain readable without diagrammatic arrows.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected before scoring because the miniature workspace includes text-like marks that could violate the no-letters constraint, and the dense well weakens thumbnail clarity.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The ordinary and Max paths are elegant, but the balance mechanism and gallery of forms make the conditional repair relationship less direct.
